item.title: Week 10: Chargers at Ravens
item.description: Mon 11/16 · 8:15 PM ET | Line: BAL -4.5 · O/U 38.5 | Model BAL 88% vs. market 66% | On paper, Baltimore has the edge, with its defense ranking 17th in EPA per dropback with motion (+0.04 allowed) against the Chargers' 32nd (-0.08), though the Chargers' defense ranks 12th in red-zone TD rate allowed (56%). Justin Herbert ranks 31st of 31 in EPA per dropback, and Zay Flowers, who gets 28% of Baltimore's targets, meets a Chargers pass defense ranked 8th. The model favors Baltimore at 88% versus 66% in the market, led by the rushing matchup (+5.4 points) and the starting QB (+3.4 points).
